project.name: mockx
project.description: MockX is a deterministic FIX-speaking mock exchange for strategy testing and simulation, combining an exact price-time order book and controlled clock with REST administration, immutable WebSocket market data, optional QuestDB persistence, and experimental ITCH/GLIMPSE feeds. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tests.environment: mockx Conda environment; outside Windows sandbox to allow asyncio loopback socketpair
